videos.title: 30 of Roblox's Top Games Didn't Exist Before October! 📈 #roblox #shorts
videos.description:
A Nov 18 check of Roblox's Top Playing Now chart found 30 of the top 99 games were made in October or November. Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, released Oct 29, was already #10, while games from before 2020 still had about 19% of the players, led by Adopt Me!
